content: कटाहः [कटमाहन्ति, आ-हन्-ड <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A frying-pan, a shallow boiler for oil or butter (of a semi-spheriodal shape and furnished with handles; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कढई</ns>); तदैव तस्मिन्निनदोऽतिभीषणो बभूव येनाण्डकटाहमस्फुरत् <ls>Bhāg. 7. 8. 16</ls>. .²2 A turtleʼs shell. .²3 A well. .²4 A hill or mound of earth. .²5 A fragment of a broken jar; ‘कटाहः खर्परस्तूपः’ इति वैजयन्ती; यद्दन्तिनः कटकटाहतटान्मिमङ्क्षोः <ls>Śi. 5. 37</ls>; <ls>N. 22. 32</ls>. .²6 A winnowing basket. .²7 Hell, the infernal regions. .²8 A young female buffalo whose horns are just appearing. .²9 A Dvīpa or division of a known continent. .²10 A heap or pile.
